title.zh: 编曲能试听一段了、Logic 工程能导出了，经验也写成了 skill
title.en: Hear a passage of an arrangement, export it as a Logic project, and the lessons written down as skills

highlights.zh: 新增 `render_arrangement_preview`：只渲染一段、可只出指定轨（默认 8 kHz 单声道）——改完立刻听；`render_arrangement_stems` 也支持按小节范围。
highlights.en: A new render_arrangement_preview renders one passage, optionally only the tracks you name, at 8 kHz mono by default, so a change can be heard at once; render_arrangement_stems takes a bar span too.

highlights.zh: 新增 `export_logic_project`：把编排写成 Logic 工程包，并能被本服务自己的导入器逐值读回。真 Logic 能否打开仍未证，写在 needs 里。
highlights.en: A new export_logic_project writes the arrangement as a Logic project, read back value for value by this server's own importer. Whether Logic itself opens it is still unproven and stays in needs.

highlights.zh: 预览怎么 A/B 写进了工具说明（同一段调两次，两条回复各自带文件与读数），音频落盘位置统一说明为 GROOVE_MCP_OUT。
highlights.en: How to A/B a preview is now in the tool text (call it twice and compare two self-describing replies), and the render family says together where the file is written.
